orbit: Approximately 50 years, between Saturn and Uranus; time per sign is uneven, roughly 2 to 8 years.
core: The deep, lasting wound and the path through it. Chiron marks where a person may feel broken, not enough, or too much, and where working honestly with that wound can become medicine they later offer others.
keyTransit: The Chiron return near age 50 brings the core wound back for confrontation, integration, and a more conscious relationship with the old pattern.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
